summary: PTC Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an October 4, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger under which Schneider Electric SE, via wholly owned Merger Sub, will acquire PTC for $205 per share in cash, making PTC a wholly owned Schneider subsidiary. PTC's board approved the deal and resolved to recommend shareholder approval. Outstanding vested RSUs and non-employee director RSUs cash out at the merger consideration plus accrued dividend equivalents. The deal implies PTC delisting from Nasdaq and Exchange Act deregistration. Watch regulatory approvals, shareholder vote timing, and any competing bid or financing condition.
